text: You should update your bank. However the top priority should be enrolling for Bituach Leumi - you can see the details about this on our website here. Your partner is now eligible for full Israeli health insurance, and they can select an HMO as part of the Bituach Leumi enrollment. Once the enrollment is complete, you can cancel the Clalit partner insurance.
